[[Stamina]] regen: +15% * [[Resistance|Slightly weak]] (1.25x) VS [[Blunt]], [[Slash]] and [[Pierce]] * Slash: +10% * Chop: +10% }} }} The '''Bear Set''' is a [[Black Forest]]-tier [[armor]] set. It has a lower armor value than the [[Bronze Armor]], but a higher armor value than the [[Troll Set]]. However, wearing all 3 pieces provides the [[Berserk]] set bonus, increasing damage, stamina and health regeneration, but making the wearer slightly more vulnerable to physical damage. Each normal [[Bear]] drops 4 Bear hides, so it will require a minimum of 4 Bear kills to craft the full set. Considering the 10% drop chance on the Bear trophy it could potentially require many more bears. == Armor pieces == This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the [[Workbench]]. 1= === Quality 1 === Workbench level: 2
